subject: NovaSmall elevated 504 bursts — triage, interim mitigation & canary rollback

From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>

Cc: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-15 09:12:03 -0700
Subject: NovaSmall — sudden 504 bursts affecting several customer routes

Markus / Marissa,

We are seeing a burst of 504 Gateway Timeouts for NovaSmall over the last 20 minutes, primarily on requests with long-context (>= 4k). Error rate has jumped from ~0.2% to 8% on the affected GPU pool. Attached is a short trace dump and a metrics heatmap indicating a spike in kernel stalls and RPC retries.

Initial observations:
- Region: us-west-2
- Model: NovaSmall-v2 (quantized)
- Time window: 08:50–09:10 PDT
- Customer impact: several enterprise customers reporting timeouts; Greentech (external) opened a ticket.

I throttled a few heavy routes and kicked a canary restart of one host — load decreased but errors persisted at ~3%. Requesting priority triage and suggestion for immediate mitigations (canary rollback to previous runtime, load shedding, or routing to dedicated fallback).

Dylan

Attachments: trace_dump_20280715.log, novasmall-metrics-heatmap.png

2) If so, schedule an immediate canary rollback for NovaSmall-v2 across the affected pool (low blast radius first).
3) Provide a concise customer-facing note for Greentech while we triage.

Marissa, can you draft a brief message to Greentech ops (cc Pete) that acknowledges the spike and sets an expectation window? Hannah — please prepare a rollback playbook and validate the snapshot we can revert to.

I'll coordinate with infra to isolate the pool and apply rate-limits on experimental routes.

-Markus

Pete —

Thanks for flagging this. We detected an elevated number of 504 timeouts affecting NovaSmall starting ~08:45 PDT. Our on-call is triaging and we've initiated a canary rollback of a recent kernel change that rolled out earlier this morning. Short update for your ops team:

- What we saw: transient 504s on long-context requests; error rate peaked ~8% and is currently tracking down to ~2.5% after partial mitigations.
- What we're doing: canary rollback of the fused-kernel build for NovaSmall on a subset of hosts; rate-limiting heavy synchronous routes; collecting traces and logs for RCA.
- ETA: we expect stabilized behavior or clearer RCA within 3 hours; we'll send an update by 1:30 PDT.
- Impact: there may be short retries from your side; please avoid aggressive client-side retries until we confirm stability.

Apologies for the disruption — we'll follow up with a post-incident summary and the mitigation artifacts.

-Marissa Cole
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-15 14:22:01 -0700
Subject: Re: NovaSmall elevated 504 bursts — triage, interim mitigation & canary rollback

Update from infra and kernel leads:

- Canary rollback completed on two host groups at 12:05 PDT; post-rollback error rate for those groups dropped to <0.3% within 20 minutes.
- Remaining affected hosts are on the older kernel path but still show intermittent RPC backpressure; we've queued a rolling restart for the remaining pool starting 15:00 PDT with small throttles.
- Root cause (preliminary): a race in the fused attention kernel that manifests under long contexts with specific prompt shapes; triggers metadata GC path that stalls worker threads.

Next steps for post-incident follow-up:
- Full RCA doc (INF-7213) with reproducer and kernel diff — assigned to infra-research.
- Release plan: disable fused-kernel flag for NovaSmall until patch is validated; add a canary guard for prompt-length distribution.
- Customer comms: send postmortem to impacted customers with timeline and mitigation details.

I'll draft the RCA and the customer-facing postmortem; Markus / Marissa please review and sign off before outbound.

-Hannah

Team / Pete,

Summary (short):
- Incident: elevated 504 Gateway Timeouts related to NovaSmall-v2 fused-kernel rollout.
- Window: 08:45–15:30 PDT (errors largely mitigated after canary rollback + rolling restarts).
- Impact: transient timeouts for several enterprise customers; worst-case error rate ~8% at peak.

Actions taken:
1) Canary rollback of fused kernel to previous stable build for NovaSmall-v2 (completed 12:05 PDT for initial groups).
2) Rolling restarts and targeted throttles applied to remaining pool (complete 15:30 PDT).
3) Disabled fused-kernel rollout flags for NovaSmall globally while infra-research prepares a fix.
4) Short customer guidance: avoid retry storms; we supplied a recommended exponential backoff window.

Artifacts and next steps:
- Trace dump and metrics snapshots attached (trace_dump_20280715.log, novasmall-metrics-heatmap.png).
- RCA ticket: JIRA INF-7213 track for postmortem and kernel patch.
- Owner: Hannah (infra-research) to produce definitive RCA and PR with patch; target ETA for patched rollout: 2028-07-22.
- Customer postmortem: Marissa to finalize and send to impacted customers by 2028-07-16 11:00 PDT.

Pete — thank you and your team for the collaboration and for applying the temporary mitigations on your side. We'll follow up with the formal postmortem and the code-level corrective actions.

-Markus
